game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Royal Granary, the king's grain stores: the squire must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while siege rats close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Granary: the king's grain stores
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Granary, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while siege rats close in. Each round, a new apples challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 150 points of apples by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Royal Granary'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Royal Granary.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
